description: Implementation of SCTP network server including connection handling, data transmission, and association management.

classes.name: sctp_send_notifier
classes.description: Notifier class for handling SCTP send events and connection shutdown.

classes.name: sctp_associaton_context
classes.description: Holds context information for each SCTP association.

classes.name: sctp_network_server_impl
classes.description: Implements SCTP network server functionalities including connection management and data handling.

methods.name: create_and_bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the SCTP socket.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives data or notifications from SCTP socket.

methods.name: handle_socket_shutdown
methods.description: Handles shutdown of the SCTP socket and associations.

methods.name: handle_data
methods.description: Processes received data for a specific association.

methods.name: init_association_with_msg
methods.description: Initializes a new SCTP association with a destination address and payload.

methods.name: handle_notification
methods.description: Handles SCTP notifications such as association change or shutdown events.

methods.name: handle_sctp_comm_up
methods.description: Handles the event when an SCTP communication is established.

methods.name: handle_association_shutdown
methods.description: Handles the shutdown of an SCTP association.

methods.name: handle_sctp_shutdown_comp
methods.description: Handles completion of SCTP shutdown for an association.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming SCTP associations.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: subscribe_to_broker
methods.description: Subscribes the socket to the IO broker for event notifications.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize an SCTP network server instance.
